name: vibecheck-linear-jev
description: A coding-agent work ledger backed by Linear whose reports are checked by a Jev-compatible judgment model.

interface.shortDescription: A checked work ledger for coding agents, backed by Linear
interface.longDescription: Record tasks, acceptance criteria, claims and handoffs as a Linear project. A Jev-compatible judgment model checks done reports, briefs, blockers and replies against the recorded plan, and status shows each task as reported and as verified.
defaultPrompt: Join this project's vibecheck-linear-jev ledger and show what needs attention.
Record this task with its acceptance criteria in the ledger.
Mark my claim complete with a report and show whether it was verified.
